summary: Add test-only controls that pin how the replication HTTP client reports a refused connection, a closed link, a refusal, an overload, a stall and a cut-off response

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild. Test-only controls; the daemon and its retry policy are unchanged.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change.

recovery.detail: Nothing to recover: the controls exist only in test builds.
